title: A Trip to the Space Centre
description: Four recordings about a school visit to a space centre: planning, a phone call, a message and a guide's talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Planning the trip
parts.intro: You will hear two friends, Ben and Mai, talking about a school trip.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Ben, are you excited about our trip to the space centre on Friday?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes, very! I want to see the big rocket. My brother says it's taller than our school.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'm more interested in the planetarium. We can watch a film about the stars.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Oh, I'd rather go to the rocket garden first. What time does the coach leave?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: At quarter past eight, not half past eight like last time. Mrs Hill told us this morning.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Good. Should I take my camera?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: You can't use cameras in the planetarium, but you can take photos outside. Bring a sandwich too. The café is very expensive.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: OK. I'll make a cheese sandwich. Oh, and do we need a jacket?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, it's often windy near the launch field.

parts.title: Part 2 · A phone call to the centre
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mr Dang, phoning the space centre.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Good morning, Space Centre. Anna speaking.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: Hello. I'm calling about a visit for my class on Friday. There will be twenty-two children.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Lovely. Would you like a guide for your group?

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: Yes, please. And can you tell me about lunch? We could eat in the café, or maybe outside.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Well, you can eat in the picnic area. It's free. The café is full on Fridays.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: Perfect. Is there a gift shop? The children always want to buy something.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Yes, but it closes at three o'clock for school groups, so please go there before that.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: That's fine. We'll leave at half past three. Thank you very much.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: You're welcome. See you on Friday!

parts.title: Part 3 · A message from a friend
parts.intro: You will hear Sam leaving a message for his friend Nam.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Hi, Nam. It's Sam. I'm calling about our space project for school.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I looked on the internet last night, and I found a lot of facts about the planets. Jupiter is the biggest one, but I think Saturn is more beautiful because of its rings.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I'm going to draw the planets on a long piece of paper. Can you bring some blue and yellow pens? I've got red and green already.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Let's meet at the library on Thursday afternoon, at four o'clock. Don't come on Wednesday, because I've got a piano lesson.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Oh, and please bring your torch. We can use it to make a model of the sun. Call me if you can't come. Bye!

parts.title: Part 4 · A guide's talk
parts.intro: You will hear a guide, Linh, talking to a group of visitors.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Welcome to the Space Centre, everyone. My name is Linh and I'm going to be your guide today.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: First, we're going to see the moon rock. It's more than four billion years old, and you can touch a small piece of it. Please wash your hands afterwards.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Next, we'll visit the rocket garden. The tallest rocket there is forty metres high. Some people think it's scary, but I think it's wonderful.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: After that, there's a short break. You can have a drink, but please don't take food into the exhibition, because it isn't allowed.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Finally, you can try the space simulator. It's the most popular thing in the centre, so you will need to wait in a queue. You must be taller than one metre twenty to go on it.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Please stay with the group. If you get lost, go to the red desk near the entrance. Now, follow me!
